name.value: Association between pack-years and left NAc volume

definition.value: The association between lifetime use of cigarettes and left NAc volume

spans.text: Of those 431 participants took part in the second wave of data collection and after exclusions for a history of stroke ( n = 8), cognitive impairments ( n = 12), and poor scan quality or missing data for the variables used in statistical analyses ( n = 96), 315 participants were available for this investigation.

value: After controlling for covariates, left NAc volume was significantly associated with lifetime use of cigarettes; the association was negative, indicating that heavier cigarette consumption correlated with smaller NAc volume.
Left hemispheric NAc volume was negatively associated with lifetime use of cigarettes.

name.value: Association between pack-years and left Put volume

definition.value: The association between lifetime use of cigarettes and left Put volume

spans.text: Of those 431 participants took part in the second wave of data collection and after exclusions for a history of stroke ( n = 8), cognitive impairments ( n = 12), and poor scan quality or missing data for the variables used in statistical analyses ( n = 96), 315 participants were available for this investigation.

value: The association between lifetime use and Put volume was positive, indicating a correlation of greater use with higher Put volume.
Larger left hemispheric Put volume was associated with greater lifetime cigarette use.

name.value: Association between age at smoking initiation and left Put volume

definition.value: The association between age at smoking initiation and left Put volume among smokers

value: In smokers, larger left hemispheric Put volume was significantly associated with a lower age at smoking initiation.
A positive association was observed between left hemispheric Put volume and age at start of smoking, with larger Put volume associated with earlier smoking initiation.
